testing.addon-testcase: Downgraded, not disabled: it stays visible in every report.
Statamic\Testing\AddonTestCase cannot boot this addon. Its setUp() calls
Nav::shouldReceive('build'), which swaps the Nav facade for a strict Mockery mock; this
addon's bootAddon() then calls Nav::extend() and the mock throws BadMethodCallException.
AddonTestCase also never invokes bootAddon() itself, so the hand-rolled call in
tests/TestCase.php would have to stay either way. Same finding as statamic-events, which
reproduced it against statamic/cms v6.26.0 with a probe test.
The bed it would replace is not incidental, and for this package less so than for its
siblings. It runs the identical suite against real MySQL via DB_DRIVER=mysql
(phpunit.mysql.xml), which is the only place the unique index this package's central
guarantee rests on is actually exercised by a real engine. It also pins app.timezone to a
zone no test uses, so a missing UTC conversion on a column that decides access cannot
hide, and stubs Statamic's licensing Outpost so the suite does not need the network.
Worth revisiting when core stops mocking Nav in AddonTestCase::setUp().
ui.page-width: `max-w-5xl 3xl:max-w-6xl mx-auto` with `data-max-width-wrapper` is core's own narrow-page
variant for detail screens — pages/forms/Show.vue:61, pages/preferences/Edit.vue:14,
pages/utilities/Licensing.vue:19 — and it is documented as such in
standards/ui-vocabulary.md §2.3. The wrapper carries `data-max-width-wrapper`, so the
header's full-width toggle still applies. The listing page uses max-w-page.
The rule reads `max-w-` literally and cannot tell the two variants apart.
release.versioning: Not suppressed, and must not be. The repository is deliberately untagged: publishing this
addon — Packagist name, Marketplace listing, first tag — is Adrian's decision, not the
building agent's. The rule is correct and has to keep firing until that decision is made.
release.screenshots: Not suppressed. Screenshots need the addon installed in the studio playground and a
browser, neither of which the machine this was built on could reach. They belong with the
Marketplace artwork alongside the rest of the family's.
